findings.title: Settings 400 assertion requires a request the validation flow never makes
findings.body: The provider validation request is a `/models` request, as demonstrated by the supplied Setup journey whose successful validation is served only from `/models`. For the 400 response, validation stops at that failed request, so this test never issues a `/chat/completions` request. Consequently, the assertion at line 41 fails even when Main correctly maps the 400 to protocol-error and preserves the unverified state. Assert that the 400 occurred on the provider-validation path (for example, `/models`), or explicitly exercise inference separately if a chat request is intended.

overall_explanation: The PID capture and tree teardown changes, net-policy aliasing, and local HTTP retry coverage are otherwise coherent. However, the new Settings E2E test deterministically fails because it requires a 400 `/chat/completions` request even though the exercised provider-validation path stops at `/models`. This blocks the required E2E gate despite the application behavior being correct.
